purpose: Test whether source-normalized deposition of each local component flux along symmetric Newtonian streamlines preserves P0652's placement gain while enforcing conservation on a sufficient numerical domain.

candidate.transport_weighting: uniform over origin plus each valid forward/backward deposition sample; normalized independently for every source cell

cross_validation.fold_definition: reuse exact P0645 five source-family-stratified folds
cross_validation.selection: none; the sole amplitude-one conservative deposition field is scored

claim_boundary: Each source cell divides its existing vector flux across its origin and valid forward/backward streamline destinations; bilinear deposition weights sum to one.
Uniform sample weights and twelve numerical steps are fixed before scoring and cannot be replaced after seeing P0655 outcomes.
The 48-arcsecond zero buffer is inherited from P0654's existing 48-cell trace cap and is not a physical scale.
All lens scores use spent RX J2129 images and cannot validate the law.
A failed gate rejects this deposition operator rather than authorizing amplitude, support, path-length, or weighting retuning.
A pass authorizes numerical and component-map robustness before any blind P0633/P0640 opening.
The projected conservative transport is not yet a covariant spacetime theory.
